description: Update a workflow's name, description, or trigger. Only the fields you pass change. Syncs the Trigger.dev schedule when the cron or trigger type changes. The trigger fields edit the workflow's one trigger; a workflow with several triggers has them edited in the dashboard instead. Changing the trigger of an active workflow that runs on a schedule, webhook or event needs the mcp:run scope; pause it first otherwise. To change steps use the step tools; to pause or resume use toggle_workflow.

description.description: New description, or null to clear it. Omit to keep the current one.

name.description: New display name, 1 to 200 characters. Omit to keep the current name.

trigger_config.description: Replaces the trigger config in full (not merged), same shape as create_workflow, e.g. { cron: "0 9 * * 1", timezone: "Australia/Sydney" }. A cron edit keeps the existing timezone unless you pass one. A webhook keeps its signing secret. Omit to keep the current config.

trigger_type.description: New trigger type (manual, schedule, webhook, vercel_event, github_event, cursor_event, linear_event, slack_event, figma_event). Omit to keep the current one.

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: update_workflow
title: Update workflow
